concerns.advisory: `NewResourceServer` now calls `s.Init(ctx)` inline, so building the entire search index moves from first-request (lazy) to process construction — Grafana startup will block for the full index build and any init failure becomes a hard startup failure instead of a per-request error.
concerns.why: pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go: new `err := s.Init(ctx); if err != nil { return nil, err }` block in NewResourceServer, paired with removal of `s.Init(ctx)` from Create/Update/Delete/Read/List/Watch/Search/History/Origin/IsHealthy/PutBlob/GetBlob.

concerns.advisory: Init is now driven by the context handed to `NewResourceServer` (a startup/wiring context) rather than a per-request context, so index build cancellation, deadlines, and any auth/tracing values now come from construction scope — worth confirming that ctx outlives and is permissive enough for a long index build.
concerns.why: `s.Init(ctx)` in NewResourceServer replaces the previous per-RPC `s.Init(ctx)` calls that used request contexts.

concerns.advisory: The init ordering swap builds the search index before `initWatcher()` starts, so writes landing between the index snapshot and watcher subscription have no path into the index unless the watcher replays from the index's resource version — the resulting freshness window should be verified.
concerns.why: pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go: the `s.initWatcher()` block was moved from before to after `s.search.init(ctx)`.

concerns.advisory: `bleveBackend.BuildIndex` no longer holds `cacheMu` across the build, so two concurrent BuildIndex calls for the same key can both construct an index (duplicate CPU/disk work, duplicate `IndexTenants` metric increments, and one index silently discarded on cache overwrite).
concerns.why: pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve.go: the function-scoped `b.cacheMu.Lock(); defer b.cacheMu.Unlock()` was replaced with a narrow lock around only `b.cache[key] = idx`.

concerns.advisory: `IsHealthy` no longer invokes Init, so the health endpoint no longer surfaces initialization errors; with init moved to construction a failed init prevents the server from existing at all, but any future lazy/retry path would report healthy while uninitialized.
concerns.why: pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go: removal of the `s.Init(ctx)` guard from `IsHealthy`.

concerns.advisory: The exported `Init` method and its `sync.Once` remain in the public surface but are now effectively internal to construction; external callers that still invoke `Init` get a no-op, which is a silent behavior change for any out-of-tree consumer of `ResourceServer`.
concerns.why: `func (s *server) Init(ctx context.Context) error` is retained and unchanged in signature while all in-repo call sites except NewResourceServer are deleted.

concerns.advisory: No test accompanies the move of initialization from per-request to construction, so neither the new startup-failure path (`NewResourceServer` returning an error) nor the reordered watcher/index sequence is covered.
concerns.why: The diff changes server.go initialization semantics but the only test file touched (module_server_test.go) merely adds a skip.

concerns.advisory: An integration test is disabled for postgres with a TODO and no tracking issue, and the stated reason ("works locally", fails in Drone) means a real environment-specific failure is being suppressed rather than diagnosed.
concerns.why: pkg/server/module_server_test.go: new `if dbType == "postgres" { t.Skip(...) }` with `// TODO - fix this test for postgres`.

concerns.advisory: The new per-init `s.log.Info("search index initialized", ...)` calls `s.search.TotalDocs()` on the startup path; if that implementation walks or queries every per-tenant index it adds cost to an already blocking startup step.
concerns.why: pkg/storage/unified/resource/search.go: added `s.log.Info("search index initialized", "duration_secs", end-start, "total_docs", s.search.TotalDocs())`.

concerns.advisory: Correcting `_, span :=` to `ctx, span :=` in `searchSupport.init`, `searchSupport.build`, and `backend.GetResourceStats` re-parents all downstream spans under these new spans, which changes existing trace shapes and can increase trace volume/cardinality for anyone with dashboards or sampling rules keyed on the old flat structure.
concerns.why: Three `_, span := ...tracer.Start(ctx, ...)` sites changed to `ctx, span := ...` in search.go and sql/backend.go.
